title: Endpaper map: the journey
brief: An original hand-drawn map of the whole journey in the edition's style: the Hill, the elf valley, the Misty Mountains, the Carrock, the great forest, the Long Lake and the Mountain. Compass rose, little vignettes of each stop, the snail at the edge.
